context.body: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Israel flees, Saul’s sons fall, Saul is wounded and dies on his sword, the armor bearer follows, and Jabesh Gilead retrieves and buries the bodies.
observations.label: Saul dies on Mount Gilboa: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps Saul, Jonathan, Saul’s sons, the armor bearer, Philistines, and Jabesh Gilead, Mount Gilboa, Beth Shan, and Jabesh, fighting, falling, requesting death, dying, displaying bodies, retrieving, burning, and burying visible within David's story or later memory.
